scope: Engineering triage safety and committed evidence consistency only; not semantic or audio approval

findings.title: Reject nonpositive batch sizes before computing pending IDs
findings.description: CLI accepts --batch -1. range(0,len(source),-1) generates no batches, so both model review and coverage validation are bypassed. process clears every reviewNeeded flag, removes uncertainty, and sets candidateReviewRequired=false. --apply persists these unsupported clearances. Reproduced with two pending sentences: clear=2, pending=0, records=[]. Validate positive batch size in process and CLI; add a regression requiring rejection before mutation.
